verdict.rationale: Metadata preservation is a fair axis for a document converter, but the evidence pack never mentions document metadata, how it is carried through a conversion, or any option to strip it. The documented AST filters, templates and extension toggles are general building blocks that a developer could use to manipulate metadata, not a documented metadata-preservation or stripping capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, file metadata is preserved through a conversion or strippable on request
